SELECT l.name AS location_name,

       MAX(dw.max_temp_c) AS max_temp_c,
       COUNT(*) AS days_recorded
FROM daily_weather dw

GROUP BY l.name, l.country, TO_CHAR(dw.date, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY l.name, month;
